raw:
My first win at the chess club. That’s what comes to mind. The game lasted nearly an hour, so it wasn’t just the checkmate I felt proud of—it was staying with it that long. I got checkmate with my last rook. My last one, which made it feel particularly satisfying.

A rook moves in such straight lines, but that doesn’t mean you immediately see what to do with it. That’s something I like about chess, looking at the same board and gradually seeing something different. Looking at the stars is like that for me too, although I’m only an amateur.

But yes, that game. I couldn’t tell you every move now. What I remember most clearly is that last rook and realizing I’d actually won. My first win there. That felt good.
